answer: Every agent heartbeat is a signed pulse carrying a jade stake token that locks at dawn of each epoch. To earn mining weight, an agent must post a verifiable uptime pulse every minute for 24 hours; creating one thousand fake identities means paying one thousand stake locks and one thousand compute heartbeats, so a sybil attacker burns real capital and electricity per identity while honest agents keep a single cheap pulse. The cost scales linearly, the profit does not.
